test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum at the rate of 12.5% per annum for 6 years is Rs. 13,500 less than the principal. Find the simple interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (principal - 13500)

Rate = 12.5%; time = 6 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal; R = rate; T = time;

**Calculation:**

⇒ S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (P - 13500) = (P × 12.5 × 6)/100

⇒ (P - 13500) = (3/4) × P

⇒ 4P - (13500 × 4) = 3P

⇒ 4P - 3P = 54000

⇒ P = Rs.54000

Simple Interest (S.I) = (P - 13500)

⇒ (54000 - 13500) = Rs.40500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.40500.**
